recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the current core BDP stable-anchor/link correction for FHIR-49613 without modifying out-of-build BDPDispense source or unrelated numeric links on other resource pages.
issue_request: FHIR-49613 was an Applied/Persuasive OO technical correction asking that BiologicallyDerivedProduct and BiologicallyDerivedProductDispense h2 sections have stable named anchors instead of generated numeric anchors, and that hardcoded numeric section links such as the module page BDP boundaries link be replaced.
initial_application: HL7/fhir#3275 initially applied the issue: commit 31d076e changed the Biologically Derived Product module link from a numeric BDP boundaries fragment to #bnr, and merge 2e682e0 added #scope and #bnr anchors for the BiologicallyDerivedProduct and BiologicallyDerivedProductDispense introduction sections.
additional_context: BiologicallyDerivedProduct remains active in core source/fhir.ini. BiologicallyDerivedProductDispense is retained in source but is no longer listed as an active core resource, and the current BDP ballot note points readers to the OO Incubator IG for it. Later BDP work added the Notes h2 and a ballot note with a hardcoded #8.25.5 link, creating a current build-scope regression against the stable-anchor requirement.
reconciliation: Changed source/biologicallyderivedproduct/biologicallyderivedproduct-introduction.xml to link to biologicallyderivedproduct.html#notes and added before the Notes h2 in source/biologicallyderivedproduct/biologicallyderivedproduct-notes.xml. No BDPDispense edit was needed because its retained source already has stable #scope/#bnr h2 anchors and it is not active in the core build.
source_changes: source/biologicallyderivedproduct/biologicallyderivedproduct-introduction.xml: replaced biologicallyderivedproduct.html#8.25.5 with biologicallyderivedproduct.html#notes in the R6 ballot note.
source/biologicallyderivedproduct/biologicallyderivedproduct-notes.xml: added the stable notes anchor before the Notes h2.
